name: wide-upright-row-dumbbell
title: Wide Upright Row: Dumbbell
primer: This is an exercise for shoulder and biceps strengthening.
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand, in front of your thighs. This is your starting position.
Raise the dumbbells up on either side of your ribs in a rowing motion by bending your elbows and moving them outwards.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.
